items.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Production game pet sprite sheet. EXACTLY FOUR columns by TWO rows, eight equal SQUARE cells, landscape canvas aspect 2:1. Input is approved identity/style reference. A tiny rounded SANDSTONE GOLEM companion, warm sand beige pebble body built from a broad round torso and short chunky stone arms and feet, gentle small dark oval eyes and smiling stone mouth, ONE tiny green sprout growing on top of its head, small turquoise heart-shaped stone inset in chest. Stubby friendly proportions, subtly textured sandstone, no fur, no animal ears, no clothes. Same seated three-quarter-front orientation, full silhouette, exact same facial proportions, head size, colors, materials and thin warm outlines in every frame. TOP ROW frames 0,1,2,3 are HUNGRY: Both stone hands rest on belly, tiny worried mouth, sprout slightly drooped. Small hand slides inward over belly then back, no torso movement. BOTTOM ROW frames 4,5,6,7 are LONELY/LOW AFFECTION: One small stone hand reaches forward slightly asking for company, gentle pleading eyes and small downturned mouth. Hand extends a little and returns, other hand rests. Each row is a quiet cycle: first pose is the sustained clear emotional resting pose, second pose starts a subtle gesture, third pose reaches the SMALL gesture peak, fourth pose recovers toward first. NOT sleepy eyes, no sleeping or crying, no joy, no large waving. Main head/forehead and feet positions MUST stay fixed across all eight cells; only pupils, eyelids, mouth and the specified little limb gesture move. No head nodding or rotation, no whole-body wobble, stretching, scale changes, jumping or per-cell recentering. Each complete pet fits central 60 percent of each cell, with at least 15 percent genuinely transparent margin on ALL sides including tail, sprout, horns and whiskers. Match the provided individual exactly. No text, grid lines, props, food, hearts, tears, particles, floor, shadows, white background or checkerboard. Actual clean alpha transparency. Soft polished illustration matching reference, no glow halos.
